articles.title: Bank holiday today? Check if SBI, HDFC, ICICI are closed on 11 July for second Saturday off — RBI calendar here
articles.summary: Public and private banks across India will remain closed today, 11 July, for the second Saturday holiday. Bank operations will remain suspended nationwide, but online banking services will remain accessible for transactions.

articles.title: Why a same-sex couple is challenging the income tax law that exempts gifts only between spouses? Explained
articles.summary: The Karnataka High Court has requested the Union government to respond to a petition challenging tax exemptions for gifts between spouses, which currently excludes same-sex couples. Details here.

articles.title: EPS 2026: New withdrawal rules and 20-day claim settlement explained
articles.summary: With EPS 2026, the pension system for organized sector employees is reformed for transparency and efficiency. It mandates a 36-month wait for withdrawal benefits, enforces a 20-day claim processing deadline, and supports higher pensions, while preserving existing benefits for current members.

articles.title: If you invested like Trump, you'd be ahead of the S&P 500 — here's what the US President is betting on
articles.summary: Trump's financial disclosures reveal he executed 21,285 stock trades in 2025, averaging one trade every five minutes. His portfolio has outperformed the S&P 500, with a 37.3% return since his inauguration. Here's a look at the US leader's portfolio .

articles.title: EPFO passbook portal restored after software upgrade; members can access accounts again ahead of 8.25% interest credit
articles.summary: The EPFO has restored its passbook portal after a two-week outage due to a database upgrade. Members can access their accounts again ahead of 8.25% interest credit.

articles.title: Same salary, different loan amount? Here's why banks may treat borrowers differently
articles.summary: Lenders consider factors beyond income when approving loans, such as repayment history and financial habits. Two individuals with identical salaries may experience different loan outcomes based on their overall financial profiles.

articles.title: Which ITR form should you file? A guide for salaried employees, pensioners and other taxpayers
articles.summary: The ITR forms have been revised for AY 2026-27, affecting ITR-1, ITR-4 and ITR-2. Taxpayers must ensure correct filing by reviewing income sources and changes to avoid complications. The filing deadline is 31 July 2026 for individuals and non-audited entities.

articles.title: Forgot your ITR login password? Here's how to reset it without access to Aadhaar-linked mobile number
articles.summary: Taxpayers can reset their income tax e-filing portal password using various methods if they forget it, even if they don't have access to their Aadhaar-linked mobile number. Step-by-step guide here.

articles.title: AMFI Data: Gold ETF inflows rebound to ₹3,443 crore in June after May outflows, here's what changed
articles.summary: Gold ETF inflows rebounded sharply to ₹3,443 crore in June, reversing May's outflows as investors returned after profit booking. Experts say cooling gold prices and persistent global uncertainties revived demand for the safe-haven asset.

articles.title: EPF vs PPF vs NPS: Which retirement scheme is meant for you?
articles.summary: Building a solid retirement corpus is crucial for financial planning. Popular schemes in India include EPF, PPF, and NPS, each differing in eligibility, contributions, and benefits. Details here.

articles.title: These value mutual funds delivered the highest returns in 5 years. Should you invest?
articles.summary: Value funds, notably HSBC and ICICI Prudential, have yielded strong returns. Experts suggest that investors adopt a mixed strategy, combining value and growth stocks, to enhance portfolio performance throughout different market cycles.

articles.title: ITR filing: Switched jobs during FY 2025-26? Follow this checklist to avoid errors
articles.summary: Employees who changed jobs during FY 2025-26 should report salary from all employers while filing ITR for AY 2026-27. Verify Form 16, Form 26AS and AIS, report total salary correctly, and avoid tax notices, interest charges and refund delays.

articles.title: Fino Payments Bank June update: Deposits rise 11%, loan referrals surge 3.5x
articles.summary: Fino Payments Bank reported an 11% year-on-year growth in deposits to ₹2,755 crore, with 3.1 lakh new accounts opened. Its loan referral business saw a 3.5x increase to ₹240 crore, but transaction throughput declined 35% due to the shift to UPI.

articles.title: Gold, silver prices today: Comex extends weekly losses amid renewed Middle East tensions
articles.summary: Precious metals saw volatility on July 10, with COMEX gold and silver futures declining due to renewed Middle East tensions and concerns over rising interest rates. Gold fell to an intraday low of $4,081, while silver dropped to $59.25, both recording weekly losses.

articles.title: SK Hynix's shares surge 14% in blockbuster US market debut amid AI frenzy

articles.title: Recently listed Waterways Leisure Tourism approves 1:10 stock split
articles.summary: Waterways Leisure Tourism announced a 1:10 stock split, pending shareholder approval, aimed at enhancing liquidity and affordability for retail investors. The stock debuted below its issue price but rallied significantly in subsequent sessions.

articles.title: Pulse of the Street: Sensex, Nifty rally on TCS earnings after midweek rout
articles.summary: On Friday, the BSE Sensex jumped 1.08% to close at 77,569.39, while the Nifty 50 gained 1.02% to settle at 24,206.90. The gains built on Thursday’s modest recovery of 0.31% and 0.34%, respectively, after Wednesday’s sharp sell-off.

articles.title: Meta stock surges 7.5% as report says AI chip production could begin this year
articles.summary: Meta Platforms shares rose nearly 7.5% to $677.9 after a report stated the company will manufacture its custom AI chip, code-named Iris, with partners Broadcom and TSMC, aiming to boost computing capacity significantly this year.

articles.title: Kusumgar IPO: Issue booked 136 times on Day 03; NII, QIB portions see huge demand, GMP signals 39% premium
articles.summary: Kusumgar Limited's IPO was oversubscribed by 136 times, with strong demand from all investor categories. articles.title: US stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq futures slip after tech-led rally; SK Hynix debut in focus
